goal: Decide if foundry-web may publish a portal release. Only the exact build that was checked and approved can go live.

app.name: foundry-web-publication
app.title: Portal publication
app.purpose: Decide, as an XACML 3.0 policy decision point, whether a portal release may be published from its producer, how it is referenced, how many core capabilities it implements, the producer state it is in and whether its target is approved.

fields.name: producer
fields.means: the producer identity: the uor-foundry repository, another producer, or one the SDK cannot verify

fields.name: reference
fields.means: an exact verified release, or a moving branch, tag, build directory or unchecked workflow artifact

fields.name: capabilities
fields.means: how many of identity, roles, shared workspaces, persistence and messaging pass their producer gates

fields.name: stage
fields.means: the producer state: producer-ready, deployment-authorized or accepted

fields.name: target
fields.means: whether the origin and subpath are the authorized /foundry-web/ Pages target

meanings.permit: XACML 3.0 section 7: the policy applies and allows publishing the release
meanings.deny: XACML 3.0 section 7: the policy applies and forbids publishing it
meanings.not-applicable: XACML 3.0 section 7: no rule of this publisher's policy applies to the request
meanings.indeterminate: XACML 3.0 section 7: the policy could not be evaluated, here because the producer identity cannot be verified

rules.why: SPEC.md Ownership: foundry-web publishes only the uor-foundry platform; it is not a second application model
SPEC.md Release boundary: verify producer identity independently; a signed SDK or valid digest alone does not establish it
SPEC.md Release boundary: acquire an exact verified release, not a moving branch, tag, build directory or unchecked workflow artifact
SPEC.md Authorized initial scope: all five core capabilities must pass; reject incomplete stage capabilities and draft previews
SPEC.md Release boundary: producer-ready precedes a separately authorized deployment
SPEC.md Publication acceptance: reject unauthorized targets; authorization binds the exact origin and subpath

app.otherwiseWhy: SPEC.md: an exact verified uor-foundry release of the complete authorized core stage, deployment-authorized, to its approved target

properties.why: a mock, draft preview or incomplete stage is not an eligible release
only exact verified releases are published
another producer's release is outside this publisher's policy

stakeholders.name: Portal publisher
stakeholders.text: Runs the foundry-web Pages workflow and needs it to deploy only verified, authorized producer bytes without rebuilding them.

stakeholders.name: Foundry owner
stakeholders.text: Authorized the first functional release and needs no draft, incomplete or unauthorized stage presented as it.

components.name: uor-foundry release
components.text: The producer repository's exact verified portal release and its evidence.

components.name: PrismPM SDK
components.text: The locked SDK that acquires the release and verifies its integrity, identity and evidence.

threats.name: Draft preview published as the core release
threats.text: A release missing one of the five core capabilities is deployed as the functional release.

control.name: Complete stage only
control.text: Fewer than five passing capabilities is denied.

threats.name: Moving reference substituted
threats.text: A branch or tag is published, so the bytes differ from the verified release.

threats.name: Deployment before authorization
threats.text: A producer-ready release is deployed before its separate deployment authorization.

threats.name: Live checks skipped after deployment
threats.text: A deployment answered permit is treated as accepted without the live journeys SPEC.md requires.
threats.accepted: The app decides whether to publish; post-deployment verification of the live URL and journeys is a separate foundry-web gate it does not replace.

quality.text: A release is permitted only when every one of the five authorized core capabilities passes.
quality.measureText: Passing core capabilities the policy requires before permit.

quality.text: No moving, incomplete, unauthorized or misdirected release is permitted.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors with an ineligible release answered permit.
